title: tf-models-official==2.12.0 conflicts python 3.8 "TypeError: unsupported operand type(s) for |: 'dict' and 'dict'"
author: Wjppppp

comments.author: Wjppppp
comments.body: I solved it by updating to python3.10 and ubuntu22.04. But this bug still needs to be solved for tfm-official-model==2.12.0 and python==3.8.

comments.body:
i have same problem.  my environment is Ubuntu 20.04, python 3.8.10(automatically installed while build docker image)
build from tensorflow:2.13.0-gpu docker image.

this is my dockerfile. I copied the requirements from the git clone models.git and using it.
FROM tensorflow/tensorflow:2.13.0-gpu

ENV PYTHONPATH "${PYTHONPATH}:/app/models"
WORKDIR /app
RUN pip install --upgrade pip
COPY requirements.txt /tmp/requirements.txt
RUN pip3 install --user -r /tmp/requirements.txt
RUN pip3 install tensorflow-text-nightly
RUN pip install -U jupyterlab
RUN apt-get update 
RUN apt install -y libgl1-mesa-glx
RUN apt install -y git-all
RUN pip install funcy
Should I have to upgrade the python version or downgrade the tensorflow docker image to 2.12?
If I have to upgrade a python version, would it be better to install tensorflow from the python docker image? and also recommend a Python version
